    BO13a, Lemma 4 a): the posets x/P have no crowns #

    For an object x of P, the nonzero morphisms out of x are ordered by φ ⪯ ψ iff ψ = φ ≫ χ (BLe). A crown of this poset (RayCat.PosetCrown) gives a crown of P (RayCat.PosetCrown.toClosedChain, using cancellation); that crown avoids a non-invertible morphism of maximal depth, so it cannot exist when P carries a twisted multiplicative basis of a minimal representation-infinite algebra (RayQuiver.MulBasis.isEmpty_posetCrown).
